_comment: Cards put into a library in a random order: Triumph of Saint Katherine's face-down pile back on top, and Endurance's graveyard to the bottom.

cards.name: Test Pile Back On Top
cards.oracle_text: When this creature is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and the top six cards of your library in a face-down pile. If you do, shuffle that pile and put it back on top of your library.

abilities.text: When this creature is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, exile it and the top six cards of your library in a face-down pile. If you do, shuffle that pile and put it back on top of your library.

cards.name: Test Graveyard To Bottom At Random
cards.oracle_text: Put all the cards from your graveyard on the bottom of your library in a random order.
